SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_PUBLICATION WHERE DELETE_YN = 'N'
AND PUB_TITLE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')

SELECT TP.PUB_ID , TP.PUB_TITLE , TP.PUB_SUB_TITLE , TP.PUB_VOLUME , TP.PUB_YEAR , TP.PUB_TYPE , TP.PUB_THUMB_FILE_ID , TP.PUB_PDF_FILE_ID , TP.BUY_URL , TP.DISPLAY_ORDER , TP.USE_YN , TP.REG_ID , TP.REG_DT
, ( SELECT ORG_FILE_NAME FROM ATCH_FILE AF WHERE AF.DELETE_YN = 'N' AND AF.ATCH_FILE_IDX = TP.PUB_THUMB_FILE_ID LIMIT 1 ) AS THUMB_ORG_FILE_NAME
, ( SELECT SAVE_FILE_NAME FROM ATCH_FILE AF WHERE AF.DELETE_YN = 'N' AND AF.ATCH_FILE_IDX = TP.PUB_THUMB_FILE_ID LIMIT 1 ) AS THUMB_SAVE_FILE_NAME
, ( SELECT ORG_FILE_NAME FROM ATCH_FILE AF WHERE AF.DELETE_YN = 'N' AND AF.ATCH_FILE_IDX = TP.PUB_PDF_FILE_ID LIMIT 1 ) AS PDF_ORG_FILE_NAME
, ( SELECT SAVE_FILE_NAME FROM ATCH_FILE AF WHERE AF.DELETE_YN = 'N' AND AF.ATCH_FILE_IDX = TP.PUB_PDF_FILE_ID LIMIT 1 ) AS PDF_SAVE_FILE_NAME
FROM TB_PUBLICATION TP
WHERE TP.PUB_ID = #{pubId} AND TP.DELETE_YN = 'N'
SELECT CONTENT_ID , PUB_ID , CONTENT_ORDER , CONTENT_NO , CONTENT_TITLE , AUTHOR_NAME FROM TB_PUBLICATION_CONTENT WHERE PUB_ID = #{pubId} AND DELETE_YN = 'N' ORDER BY CONTENT_ORDER ASC
